steps.reason: Scope the full dataset to ensure clean, consistent transaction records before graph construction — no specific date/account/amount filter, so all data is included.
Compute per-account features such as rapid in->out ratio and velocity, which help characterize accounts acting as collection hubs in a fan-in ring.
Core tool for this query — detects fan-in rings (multiple accounts funneling money into one) and short cycles that indicate coordinated layering or collection networks.
Flag accounts within detected rings that also exhibit rapid_movement behavior (fast in->out), reinforcing ring membership with rule-based evidence.
Combine graph ring findings, rule hits, and computed features into a final LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk rating per flagged account for analyst review.
